pages.text: These artifacts are in the Atem Pharaoh’s loot pool. Use four matching Torches of Atem to target it. An untuned ritual can also drop them.
Helmet of the Atem set. Equip it with the Body, Legs, and Feet for the full set’s emergency recall.
Chestplate of the Atem set. Equip all four pieces to activate the set bonus.
Leggings of the Atem set. The recall requires the Eyes, Body, Legs, and Feet together.
Boots of the Atem set. At full set, a lethal hit can heal and recall you to your spawn. The effect has a 20-minute cooldown.
A sword with a chance on a successful hit to grant the wielder brief Resistance.
A shield that may grant a short period of damage immunity when a living attacker strikes while you block.
A fishing rod with its own fishing loot pool in Atum. Use it at a water source as you would a normal rod.
Use this portable recall to teleport to your valid spawnpoint. If your bed is missing, it falls back to the applicable world spawn. Each successful use costs durability.
